newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat steady/lower; corn, soy off.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat steady/lower; corn, soy off.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf wheat values were steady to lower on Monday in very quiet conditions as the market remained in a holiday mode, export sources said.
Corn and soybean nearby bids were slightly lower amid slack demand.

Brokers noted USDA's wheat export inspection figure of 4.5 million bushels for the week ending December 26 was the lowest since 1982 when USDA began keeping computerized records and well below the previous week's tally of 13.5 million bushels.
In export news, Tunisia bought 26,000 tonnes of soybean meal for January/February shipment.
